Scene.Description: The Grayson family sits at the dinner table. Mark is about to tell his parents the good news.

Shot.ShotInstructions: Mark enters the dinning room and sits at the table. Debbie finishes setting the table

Prop.Usage: Held by Debbie. Placed on the table out of view for the rest of the scene.

Dialogue.Text: And a big welcome home to my favorite son.

Shot.ShotInstructions: A close-up of Debbie as she sits at the table opposite to Mark

Dialogue.Text: I made some chicken, but I also heated up some authentic German bratwurst flown in special today, just for you.

Shot.ShotInstructions: A close-up of Mark sitting at the opposite side of the table

Dialogue.Text: I... had a pretty interesting day.

Shot.ShotInstructions: Nolan arrives at the dinner table in a blur of motion, kisses Debbie on her forehead, and sits at the table.

Prop.Usage: Almost tips over as Nolan enters the dining room. Is caught by Debbie and repositioned.

Dialogue.Text: Sorry I'm late. Honest to God, a dragon was attacking Hong Kong. I stopped it.
Ooh, a dragon. Nice. Mark was getting ready to tell us how interesting his day was.

Shot.ShotInstructions: Point of view from Noland and Debbie facing towards Mark.

Dialogue.Text: Guess who's finally getting his powers? Haha.

Shot.ShotInstructions: Focus on Nolan's reaction as he processes Mark's news.
Focus on Mark as he responds, uncertain of his father's excitement.

Dialogue.Text: Pretty sure. Threw a trash bag into space. At work.

Shot.ShotInstructions: Point of view behind Mark facing towards Nolan and Debbie.
Point of view from underneath the table. Debbie kicks Nolan's foot to regain his attention.
Noland, perks up to respond appropriately to the situation.

Dialogue.Text: Oh, that's great, son, just great! If you're up for it, i'll make some time tomorrow for training.
Bright and early tomorrow, Mark. Make sure you get a good night's sleep.

Shot.ShotInstructions: Focus on Mark as he responds, elated at his father's response.
